description: Department of Forest Conservation - Declare that Getadiwula Forest as reserved forest in Kurunegala District and other Forest Conservation District under Forest Conservation Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of forest reserves under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes legal/regulatory action. It establishes new protected areas through statutory instruments, references specific legal amendments, and creates binding legal designations - all characteristic of Legal/Regulatory gazettes. While it mentions the President's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than personnel appointment or portfolio assignment, so government classification types do not apply.
